#             lines; uses only paired mussels, so n is small)
#   2-SAMPLE: does the arm's day-3 distribution differ from the baseline reference pool?
#             (matches the boxes; uses all pool animals and all arm animals)
# Both are computed for EVERY day-3 arm, including the control arm. Nothing is assumed
# about which arms can be paired; n_pairs is reported and the paired columns are NA when
# there are fewer than two pairs.
delta_mean = if (nrow(paired) >= 1) mean(paired$post - paired$base) else NA_real_)
